## Où j'en suis
SAML ACS signature and condition verification is implemented with signxml, with a 120-second clock-skew tolerance and Redis-based replay protection. The work is in PR #412, which the facts record as merged. The tests pass (1284 passed, 3 skipped). Fernhill's staging IdP metadata is still to be loaded before the Thursday demo.

- [prochaine-étape] Load Fernhill's staging IdP metadata and send them our staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD, for the Thursday 10:00 New York demo.
- [prochaine-étape] Create a separate ticket to enforce SSO and disable password login for Fernhill users.
- [essai-raté] python3-saml/xmlsec failed on the Alpine image: libxml2 mismatch with lxml, and building lxml from source did not fix it.
- [décision] Use signxml instead of python3-saml, and remove xmlsec from the image (source: t08).
- [décision] Clock skew is 120 seconds, per the Fernhill contract annex (source: t12).
- [décision] Password login is not changed in this PR, handled as a separate ticket (source: t12).
